workflow: Update working_on, next_steps, completed/remaining work, stages, validation and goal status in PROGRESS-CONTEXT.json after meaningful work changes; run the report writer with --write to refresh the latest report between checkpoints.

Before each new checkpoint, add its human-readable summary and precise scope limit under checkpoint_summaries. New L2 adoption rules import Publication from audit_l2_publication_v2, preserving the historical v1 backend and old replay verifiers unchanged.

The v2 backend checks report context during read-only preflight, renders the prospective report without writes, then writes/verifies PROGRESS.md and its checkpoint snapshot as part of successful publication.

For any other checkpoint helper that does not use the reporting backend, run the report writer --write immediately after checkpoint publication and --verify before reporting success. The Markdown companion is required for every future CHECKPOINT-N.json.

Preserve immutable PROGRESS-N.md snapshots and their metadata. Between-checkpoint updates modify only PROGRESS.md, PROGRESS-STATE.json and reporting context. Do not edit canonical audit evidence just to change report prose.

Keep the user report readable: completed work, current work, remaining scope, actual implementation/review/test status and material limits. Do not convert overlapping queue/line counts into bug counts or an invented completion percentage.
